title: Range Of Tolerance Maximum Range
definition: The Range of Tolerance is the span of environmental conditions (temperature, salinity, pH, etc.) within which an organism can survive, grow, and reproduce, with the 'Maximum Range' representing the absolute physiological limits beyond which the organism faces mortality.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding species distribution, climate change impacts, and biodiversity loss, frequently appearing in Prelims (Environment/Ecology) and Mains (GS Paper III: Conservation).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Range Of Tolerance Maximum Range.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
